scripts.dev: bun run build && sh scripts/rust.sh run --locked -p xtask -- serve
scripts.test: sh scripts/test-preview-pool.sh && sh scripts/rust.sh test --locked -p xtask -p profile-app && sh scripts/rust.sh run --locked -p xtask -- verify-profile
scripts.lint: sh scripts/rust.sh fmt -p xtask -p profile-app -- --check && sh scripts/rust.sh clippy --locked -p xtask -p profile-app --all-targets -- -D warnings && sh scripts/rust.sh clippy --locked -p profile-app --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.dev-check: bun run lint && bun run build && bun run test
